name: @jason-vaughan/openclaw-ebay-seller
description: eBay seller automation for your OpenClaw agent — connect your own eBay seller account via OAuth, read inventory/offers/orders/business-policies, and draft + publish listings behind an approval gate. Direct REST via authorization_code OAuth (your seller token, stored locally). Hard-gated writes for anything that touches live listings or money.
author: Jason Vaughan

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
